reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.comment: I recently purchased a set of be quiet! fans for my PC build, and I have to say they were absolutely worth the money. The build quality is excellent and installation was straightforward, but the most impressive part is just how quiet they are. When I first powered on my computer, I genuinely had to double-check that the fans were even spinning because I couldn’t hear them at all. That’s not an exaggeration—they are that quiet. Even under load, the noise level is practically nonexistent compared to other fans I’ve used. At the same time, they still move plenty of air and keep my system running cool. It’s a rare combination of strong performance and near-silent operation. If you’re building a PC and want something high quality that won’t sound like a jet engine sitting on your desk, these fans are definitely worth the investment. I’d buy them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Gavin

reviews.title: Excellent 120mm fan and quiet!
reviews.comment: My Cooler Master Hyper212X stock fan started rattling more and more so i was searching around for a good replacement for it.  Couldn't find what I was looking for so I had to get a different brand of a fan to install.  After looking around for a bit, this particular fan caught my eye because it has a 4 pin PWM connector on it with plenty of cable length and the RPM for the fan speed was perfect for what i needed (2100RPM).  I'm glad i still had my other mounting brackets from my original heatsink box which lay flat against this fan so the install for the brackets onto the fan was pretty easy.  The 120mm design was also perfect.  For anyone who is looking for a 120mm fan as a replacement for a heatsink, this is a really good choice.  Been running this fan since January and haven't had any issues with it yet.  Very quiet as well!  Mounting the brackets onto the fan itself was easy and so far the performance has been excellent.  I have no complaints about this fan.  This fan is made using a rifle bearing sleeve so you get the best of both worlds.  I'm very glad i chose this fan over others and i hope i get many years of use out of it.

reviews.title: be quiet! Pure Wings 3 120mm is silent and it moves air too
reviews.comment: The be quiet! Pure Wings 3 120mm is a good case fan if you want silence. It moves a fair amount of air for being so quiet. I got 120mm be quiet! fans in a case now going on four years old and still working great.
reviews.author: Patrick F. Sullivan

reviews.title: Excellent upgrade to the Thermalright Frozen Prism 240 Black AIO fans
reviews.comment: I have been using the original Thermalright Frozen Prism 240 Black AIO 120mm fans, which were pretty good. Unfortunately 1 of them went bad and started making a loud grinding noise, despite nothing touching the blades. I picked up two of these Pure Wings to replace the bad fan as well as the other Thermalright, and I have to say both the airflow and noise level are noticeably improved. My CPU temperatures are a little lower on average (about 2 to 3 degrees centigrade) when playing Cyberpunk 2077 or working in really demanding office files. The fans typically run between 55% and 75% during my office tasks, and they ramp up to 100% generally when gaming. Even then, the sound is a pretty soft hum. It's noticeable if I lower the volume on everything, but when playing at a normal volume or with my headphones on I never notice the sound. The sound is certainly less noticeable than my GPU fans, which are quite loud above 70%. I can't comment on their lifespan yet. The first couple weeks of using these fans has been great, so if they continue this way I will be quite happy.
